facts.fact: Gauri, 38, is Dhanu's elder sister (not his wife); Mini, 6, is Dhanu's daughter and calls him Baba. Supersedes F534. Mini's mother is not mentioned.
The Ewe's Rest pen wall was built by Dhanu and Gauri's father; Dhanu and Gauri carried the stones.
Ila tells Gauri she can lie to anyone but her bound partner for free, and chooses not to.
